scope: IPL 2022-2026; innings 1 and 2; 367 matches; 87,673 delivery rows
model_v2_pressure_rule: Pressure score is built from pre-delivery scoring stress versus empirical expected scoring, wickets already lost, and match phase. A phase- and innings-specific 70th percentile cutoff is used, with a floor of 35, to avoid applying one absolute threshold to every phase.
batter_role_groups: Opener (median batting order 1-2), Middle order (3-5), Finisher (6-7)
bowler_role_groups: Predominant legal-ball phase: Powerplay, Middle, or Death
important_caveats: V2 is a sensitivity/alternative model, not yet established as superior to V1.
The phase-specific percentile pressure threshold makes the number of high-pressure balls more balanced across phases but does not prove that all selected states are equally difficult.
Batter role is approximated using median batting order; players can perform multiple roles.
Bowler role is approximated using predominant phase of legal deliveries; specialist and multi-phase roles may be misclassified.
Composite scores are relative within role groups and are not probabilities.
The current V2 bowler top 10 still includes negative runs-saved-per-six values; negative values must be shown honestly.
Need additional match-level validation and sensitivity checks before selecting V2 as final.
